records.method_takeaway: Polynomial local GAT/multiplicative updates precede linear global attention; shared Q/K by default. ReLU variant is distinct from no-ReLU Polynormer. Linear global attention avoids dense NxN scores, but each member still performs its own projections and reductions.

released_dataset_split_preprocessing_sch.paper_schedule_discrepancy: Paper Table 5: warmup 200, total 1,000. Released main sums local 200 and global 1,000 to give 1,200. Recommendation chooses the release explicitly.
released_dataset_split_preprocessing_sch.published_result: Paper Table 1: Polynormer-r Photo 96.46 ± 0.26 std over 10 runs. README 96.67 is one first run.

records.GNNM_integration_implication: Selected Photo base. Private stem and local/global class heads with common interior modules retain four complete local and global trajectories. Hop tokens: 3 hops. Photo AdamW lr 0.01, wd 1e-5, dropout 0.1, 1 head, batch 2,000. SGPM used four H800 80 GB GPUs; downstream used a 3090 Ti 24 GB GPU.

Commented Photo SGPM args give batch 64, lr 1e-4 and 3 epochs. Exact Photo downstream walk mixture, hidden dimensions and scheduler command remain unresolved.

records.GNNM_integration_implication: A later strong Photo alternative. Charge graph pretraining, token generation/storage and every private downstream trajectory. Its NAGphormer ancestry does not disqualify an attributed GNNM extension.
records.open_issue_next_decision: Defer from the first amendment because the exact Photo release command and full pretraining/token custody are unresolved. Its 60% training result is not evidence for the current 20% teacher-training roles.
